Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Bars
Punchline: Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job.
Description:
Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job. Pick a hotbar, choose "Show only on" or "Hide on", and click the jobs it applies to. More hotbar magic is in the works!

Open the settings with /willobars.
Changelog:
- Ask before deleting a saved settings file
- Keep working when the save folder can't be reached
- Show hidden hotbars again when Will-o-Bars is turned off

Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Muter
Punchline: Mutes the ambient sounds when a crowd gathers around you.
Description: Tired of noisy crowds? Will-o-Muter mutes the Ambient Sounds channel when many players are nearby and restores your volume once the crowd thins out. Open the settings with /willomuter.
Changelog:
- Keep your ambient volume if you change it while muted
- Keep typed slider values within their limits

Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Patchwisp
Punchline: Patch notes for your Dalamud plugins.
Description: Shows the changelogs of your Dalamud plugins when they update (falling back to GitHub releases when a plugin has none), lists and installs updates waiting in your plugin repositories, and shows the current changelog of every installed plugin. Open it with /patchwisp.
Changelog: - Show a spinner while checking for updates, and what the check found
